ebike_rental.h1: E-Bike Rental in Dro, Lake Garda
ebike_rental.meta_description: Rent an e-bike in Dro: Flyer Gravel, City eBike and eMTB, helmet and lock included. Book and pick up in store, open every day.
ebike_rental.intro: Just steps from Lake Garda, we rent Flyer e-bikes to explore the valleys of Trentino: Gravel and City eBikes for the cycle path and gravel roads, eMTBs for the mountains. Every rental includes a helmet and lock, and you can rent several bikes together for a group or family.

emtb_rental.h1: eMTB Rental in Dro, for Lake Garda and the Brenta Dolomites
emtb_rental.meta_description: Rent an eMTB in Dro: Flyer Front, Full Alu and Full Carbon models. Prices for 1 to 7 days, helmet and lock included.
emtb_rental.intro: Garda Trentino is one of Italy's most loved eMTB destinations, with gravel roads, single tracks and white roads toward Monte Stivo and the Brenta Dolomites. We rent Flyer eMTBs in three builds — Front, Full Alu and Full Carbon — for an afternoon or a whole holiday.

gravel_rental.h1: Gravel Bike Rental in Dro, Lake Garda
gravel_rental.meta_description: Rent an electric gravel bike in Dro for the white roads of Garda Trentino. Prices for 1 to 7 days, helmet and lock included.
gravel_rental.intro: The gravel roads and cycle paths around Lake Garda are gravel bikes' natural ground. We rent Flyer Gravel eBikes for riders who want to move fast between Dro, Arco and Riva del Garda, solo or over longer routes.

ebike_repair.h1: E-Bike Repair and Maintenance in Dro
ebike_repair.meta_description: Repair and maintenance of e-bikes, road bikes, mountain bikes and scooters in Dro. Bring your bike to our shop, open every day.
ebike_repair.intro: We repair and maintain e-bikes, road bikes, mountain bikes, scooters and any type of bicycle. Bring your bike to our shop in Dro: we check the problem and tell you the time and cost before we start.

ebike_rental_drena.h1: E-Bike Rental for Drena, between Dro and Monte Stivo
ebike_rental_drena.meta_description: Rent an e-bike in Dro to reach Drena and the slopes of Monte Stivo: woods, hamlets and trails in the hinterland of Garda Trentino. Prices for 1 to 7 days.
ebike_rental_drena.intro: Drena is one of the most popular destinations for our e-bike rentals: our routes toward Monte Stivo and Monte Velo pass right through here, among woods, clearings and small hamlets in the hinterland above Arco. We'll set you up with the right eMTB for the climb and point you to the ride that fits your level.

ebike_rental_sarche.h1: E-Bike Rental for Sarche and the Valle dei Laghi
ebike_rental_sarche.meta_description: Rent an e-bike in Dro to reach Sarche and the Valle dei Laghi, passing through Pietramurata on the Sarca cycle path. Prices for 1 to 7 days.
ebike_rental_sarche.intro: From Dro, the cycle path along the Sarca river leads to Pietramurata and then Sarche, the gateway to the Valle dei Laghi toward Ponte Arche and Comano. It's the crossing point of some of our longest routes, with real climbs toward the area's mountain huts. Rent the right e-bike here to take them on.

ebike_rental_cavedine.h1: E-Bike Rental for Lake Cavedine, in the Valle dei Laghi
ebike_rental_cavedine.meta_description: Rent an e-bike in Dro for an easy ride to Lake Cavedine, in the Valle dei Laghi: gentle elevation gain, suitable for families too. Prices for 1 to 7 days.
ebike_rental_cavedine.intro: The ride to Lake Cavedine, in the Valle dei Laghi, is one of our easiest routes: little elevation gain, effortless on an e-bike, suitable for families and less trained riders too. A simple way to discover scenery different from Lake Garda's, just minutes from Dro.

ebike_rental_marocche.h1: E-Bike Rental at the Marocche di Dro
ebike_rental_marocche.meta_description: Rent an e-bike right in Dro for the Marocche, the ancient landslide area behind the landscape of the Valle dei Laghi. Prices for 1 to 7 days.
ebike_rental_marocche.intro: The Marocche, the ancient landslide that shaped the landscape between Dro and the Valle dei Laghi — even forming Lake Cavedine itself — are a few steps from our shop. Rent your e-bike here and set off to explore the area without moving the car.

ebike_rental_toblino.meta_description: Rent an e-bike in Dro to reach Lake Toblino, with its famous castle perched over the water, in the Valle dei Laghi. Prices for 1 to 7 days.
ebike_rental_toblino.intro: Lake Toblino, with its castle perched over the water, is one of the most photographed views in Trentino — and one of the highlights our e-bike routes toward the Valle dei Laghi pass along the way. Rent your e-bike here for a comfortable ride there from Dro.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.meta_description: How we handle the data of people who visit the site, in line with GDPR.
privacy.data_body:
If you only browse: your IP address and the technical details of the request (browser, page requested), needed to show you the site and protect it from abuse. With your consent, Google Analytics (GA4) collects browsing data (pages visited, session duration, device type).

If you create an account: first name, last name, email address and password (which we keep only in encrypted form); optionally your phone number, and the language you prefer. If you sign in with Google we receive your first name, last name and email address from Google, not your password.

If you rent a bike, in the shop too: first and last name, your contact details (phone and email, if you give them), the details of the rental (dates, bike, amount) and, for the shop's own use, any practical notes (for example your helmet size).
privacy.legal_basis_body: Managing your account and your rentals is based on the performance of a contract or of pre-contractual steps you asked for (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR); keeping the data of rentals for the time the law requires is based on a legal obligation (point (c)). Protecting the site and the features you ask for, such as the maps, are based on our legitimate interest in giving you a safe and working site (point (f)). Statistical analysis with Google Analytics is based on your consent (point (a)), given through the cookie banner on your first visit and revocable at any time.
privacy.cookies_body: We use necessary technical cookies: the one that remembers your cookie choices (cc_cookie, six months) and, only if you sign in, the session cookies of your account (sb-…-auth-token, up to 400 days), without which we could not recognise you from one page to the next. With your consent, we use third-party analytics cookies (Google Analytics). You can change your consent at any time by clicking "Cookie settings" in the footer.
privacy.retention_body:
Your account data stays as long as the account exists. If you delete it from the settings, we delete the account and, if you have no rentals, your customer record too; if you have already rented, the record with the data of those rentals stays in the shop's archive for the time needed for legal and accounting obligations, but is no longer linked to an account.

Data collected through Google Analytics is kept for 14 months, according to GA4's default configuration.
privacy.third_parties_body:
Browsing data is transmitted to Google LLC (1600 Amphitheatre Parkway, Mountain View, CA 94043, USA), acting as a data processor under Art. 28 GDPR. Google LLC participates in the EU-US Data Privacy Framework. More information: policies.google.com/privacy. This website is hosted on a server of Oracle Cloud Infrastructure located in Milan (Italy). Traffic goes through Cloudflare, Inc. (101 Townsend St, San Francisco, CA 94107, USA), which processes network data (IP address, HTTP headers) as part of its network and security services (DNS, protection against attacks, temporary storage of files). Cloudflare, Inc. participates in the EU-US Data Privacy Framework. More information: cloudflare.com/privacypolicy.

To manage accounts we use Supabase (Supabase Inc.), with the data stored in Ireland (EU). Service emails, such as the confirmation of your address and the recovery of your password, are sent through Resend (Resend, Inc., USA). If you choose to sign in with Google, Google LLC gives us the data listed above.
privacy.browser_body: When you open the 3D map of a route, your browser loads the imagery and the terrain directly from Esri (ArcGIS) and Cesium ion; when you click to load the map in the contact section, it loads it from Google Maps. These services receive your IP address and may set their own cookies.
privacy.rights_body: Under Arts. 15–22 GDPR you have the right to: access your data, request its rectification or erasure, restrict its processing, object to processing, request data portability, and withdraw consent at any time. From your account settings you can also correct your data, download a copy of it and delete the account yourself. You also have the right to lodge a complaint with the Italian data protection authority (Garante per la protezione dei dati personali). To exercise these rights, contact us at:
privacy.contact_body: For any requests related to data processing: privacy@lelettricaleoni.com
